name: Survive Your Ideas
desc:
✏️ Type ANY word. It happens. Can you survive?

💥 Every round, one random player writes a word… and it COMES TO LIFE!
🌊 Tsunami? 🦖 Dinosaur? ☢️ Nuke? 🌮 Tacos? Anything goes.
😈 Words stack up, chaos keeps growing. Last one alive WINS!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to get new words first!

llm.loop: each round one random player types a word -> it spawns as a disaster/object -> everyone tries to survive the stacking chaos -> last alive wins
llm.objectives: be the last player alive as typed words come to life
llm.instructions: type any word and it happens; one random player writes a word each round; words stack; last one alive wins
unique: free-text words become in-game disasters/objects (AI or large word library)
llm.thumbnails: text boxes with SEND buttons (TSUNAMI, SHARK, APOCALYPSE, LAVA, UFO, 67) spawning a wave, shark, meteors, volcano and UFO
llm.complexity_notes: word-to-object/disaster generation system with large content library or AI, stacking hazard effects
